_source: Sim-mode match events (agreed with Carlos Oct 9; numbers are PROPOSALS): scorers, assists, cards, injuries, substitutions and 1-10 match ratings. Form = average of the last 10 match ratings (decided).
_cardsNote: Realistic card rates (decided): about 1.8 yellows and 0.1-0.13 reds per team per match (the yellow rate is set a little higher because sent-off players and second yellows take some away). Two yellows = sent off. A red card weakens the team for the rest of the match (-25% attack, +25% conceded, scaled by the time left). A booked player is careful: 75% of the time a second booking goes to a team-mate instead (keeps sendings-off for two yellows realistic).
_ratingNote: Match rating 1-10 (average about 6.5, so form stays around development.json's neutral 6.5): 6.4 + win 0.4 / loss -0.4 + 0.9 per goal + 0.5 per assist + clean sheet (GK 0.7, defenders 0.4) - 0.15 per goal conceded (GK and defenders) + 0.04 x (his rating - team average) + random (sd 0.5; Professional x0.7, Maverick x1.6) - 0.3 yellow - 1.5 red. Under 20 minutes on the pitch: no rating.
_subsNote: AI substitutions: 3-5 a match between minutes 55 and 85, the most tired starters first, when the bench has someone fit for the slot. An injury forces a substitution if any are left.
_injuryNote: Injuries in matches (Carlos Oct 9): about 3.6% per player per 90 minutes (elite football: about 24 injuries per 1000 match hours). Tired players get hurt more: +2% of the risk per energy point below 70. Healthy x0.5, Thoroughbred x1.5, Lucky Charm reduces the whole team's risk. Types and lengths in data/rules/injuries.json; the Medical Building's recovery multiplier applies (facilities.json).
